integrity: Proof is analytic and the standalone checker supplies reproducible rational test cases, not an independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact for autonomous two-patch logistic source-sink dynamics with two positive travel-loss fractions, fixed reverse dispersal, constant coefficients, and a rare-mutant local-invasion criterion. No inference for stochastic extinction, broader models or empirical management. Historical priority remains provisional because some related papers were accessible only in abstract.
title: A sharp biomass-gain threshold for lossy source-to-sink migration
